headline: The council took up a supplemental investment program for the health office and asked for a report on a drainage project.

glance.text: The health office asked for two more barangay health stations and six months of medicine.
A resolution asks the engineering office to report on the drainage project by March.

items.text: The appropriations committee recommended approval; a member asked for the fund source.
The council approved the request for a progress report without objection.

issues.summary: Two stations and six months of medicine, funded from savings.
The engineering office is to report by March.

meta.model: written by hand, as an example
